mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the assembled arm to the brain and spinal cord brought the sensory and motor pathways together and explained their role in adjusting movement.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the motor and stretch pathways was clear but repetitive; neither fitting added much explanation on its own.

surprise.text: The explanation that muscle stretch contributes to our sense of limb position gave the stretch pathway a clearer purpose.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary. The named slots and compatible options made the fittings understandable, although their order seemed inconsequential.

continue.text: I would be somewhat interested in another chapter to see how the arm depends on other body systems, though I would hope for fewer repetitive fittings and more explanations connecting the parts.
